title: Valentine wish page with evasive No button, Yes celebration overlay, sweet message, and photo section

requirements.text: Update the Valentine landing page to present a clear Valentine’s Day wish prompt with two options: a “Yes” button and a “No” button, replacing the current single CTA button in the hero section.

quotes: make a valentine day wish page where should be message and button should be there for option yes and No

acceptanceCriteria: The hero section shows a primary Valentine wish question/message and exactly two visible actions labeled “Yes” and “No”.
The previous single hero CTA (“Explore Memories”) is no longer the primary interaction shown in the hero section.

requirements.text: Implement an evasive/escaping behavior for the “No” button so that when the user tries to click it (hover/tap attempt), it moves away repeatedly and remains difficult to click, encouraging the user to click “Yes”. Use the existing placeholder hook file `frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts` to encapsulate the behavior.

quotes: when you want to click no it should be escape again and again then you have to click yes

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, when the pointer approaches/hover-starts on the “No” button, the button relocates to a different position within a defined container without leaving the viewport.
On touch devices, the first tap attempt on “No” causes it to move (i.e., it should not be trivially clickable).
The “No” button movement is constrained so it never overlaps the “Yes” button and never becomes permanently unreachable.
When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is enabled, the “No” button does not animate evasively; instead it remains stable (or uses a minimal, non-animated fallback).

requirements.text: On “Yes” click, show a celebratory overlay that includes a crackers/confetti-style burst plus sparkles/light effects in the background, and then reveal a sweet acceptance message. Implement the celebration visuals in `frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverlay.tsx` (currently empty) and wire it into `frontend/src/features/valentine/ValentinePage.tsx`.

quotes: once clicked it displaying crakers animation sparkles light in the background and there should be some sweet meassage

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Yes” triggers an on-screen celebration layer (confetti/crackers burst + sparkles/lights effect) that is visibly distinct from the existing floating hearts/background particles.
After clicking “Yes”, a sweet message is displayed prominently in the page content (English).
The celebration overlay can be dismissed automatically after a short duration or via an explicit close action, and it does not block scrolling/interaction indefinitely.
When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is enabled, the celebration uses a reduced-motion alternative (e.g., static sparkles/glow + message without heavy motion).

requirements.text: Add a photo section to the Valentine page that displays “some photos” (a small gallery/grid or polaroid-style cards) below the main interaction, using static frontend assets (do not load photos from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: The page includes a dedicated photo area showing at least 3 images.
Images are loaded from `frontend/public/assets/generated` (or other frontend static public path) and rendered directly by the frontend.
The photo layout is responsive (1 column on small screens, multi-column on larger screens) and visually consistent with the Valentine theme.

requirements.text: Move all new user-facing copy for the Valentine wish flow (question text, Yes/No labels if customized, sweet acceptance message, and any helper text) into `frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts`, and ensure the Valentine page renders those strings from the config in English.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: All newly introduced Valentine wish text is sourced from `valentineConfig` (not hardcoded in the component).
All displayed copy for this flow is English.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`.
Do not serve images via the backend; render static images from the frontend public assets directory.
nonGoals: Implementing Internet Identity login/profile/memories backend flows (not required for this Valentine wish interaction).
Using external image hosting or third-party APIs for photos/animations.

Romantic photo-style illustration 2, warm Valentine color grading (valentine-photo-2.dim_1200x800.png)
